reviewMethod: Full-clip three-point samples, finer candidate checks; visually identified. Source-relative seconds. Stable within ~1 second; manual refining recommended for final edit.
summary: 14 other clips reviewed. Clear installed DMX terminator on LED bar in IMG_0774, alternate IMG_0773. No USB-C/ENTTEC close-up in this subset. Strong extra details: moving-head address, laser ports/DIPswitches, LEDbarcontrols, laptop response.
